lines.zh: 踏着落叶前行，沙沙作响。
树枝轻轻摇晃，带我前行。

lines.en: Leaves rub, making a deep sound.
Leaves accompany me through the woods.
Twigs rub, making a faint sound.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，脚下的地裂了。
lines.en: I dropped from above; the ground cracked.
The crater of my landing is still smoking.
I stand stiff as a black pillar.

lines.zh: 空洞的眼神，仿佛能看透一切。
凝视，让你感到毛骨悚然。

lines.en: Stare at you, making you uneasy.

lines.zh: 目光锐利，仿佛能看到灵魂。

lines.en: Stare directly at you, making you awe.

lines.zh: 眼神穿透你，你感到害怕。
lines.en: Eyes penetrate you, making you afraid.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，让你无所遁形。
lines.en: Eyes like torches, making you visible.

lines.zh: 盯着你看，你感到不寒而栗。
lines.en: Stare at you, making you chilled to the bone.

lines.zh: 目光如电，你不敢移开视线。
lines.en: Eyes like lightning, making you look away.

lines.zh: 我看你时，你的边界在波动。
lines.en: When I look at you, your edges waver.

lines.zh: 我在衡量你属于哪个世界。
lines.en: I am judging which world you belong to.
Hold still. There is something behind you.

lines.zh: 这具身体，本就不属于这个世界。
lines.en: This body never belonged to this world.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the torch in your hand.

lines.zh: 你散发的气息让我着迷。
我看到你了，这让我兴奋。

lines.en: Your existence means something to me.
I am drawn to your light.

lines.zh: 让开，我得回那条缝里去。
lines.en: Move. I have to get back to that rift.
I fall from above and land here.
Come with me and don't look back.
We are drawn to each other.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，双脚还没落地。
lines.en: I fall from above; my feet have not landed.
I want to be with you.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下来，没打算走。
lines.en: I dropped in from above, and I am not leaving.

lines.zh: 从树枝滑下，发出吱吱声。
lines.en: Squeaks as it slides from the branch.

lines.zh: 树叶摩擦着发出沙沙声。
树叶被风吹动，发出声音。
捡起一片树叶，品尝一下。
用叶子擦拭自己的毛皮。
lines.en: Wipes its fur with a leaf.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，眼中闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: Locks onto the target, its eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 靠近目标，树叶沙沙作响。
嗅探目标，试图找到气息。
我从天而降时，阴影先到。
lines.en: When I drop from above, my shadow lands first.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，准备一击毙命。
lines.en: Aims for the target, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，等待最佳时机。
lines.en: Locks onto target, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，眼神锐利如刀。
lines.en: Locks onto target, eyes sharp as blades.

lines.zh: 剧情走到这一步，该你了。

lines.en: I have chased you across three worlds.
I settle the rules you broke.

lines.zh: 你身上有不该带的东西。
lines.en: You carry something you should not.

lines.zh: 这条结局线，需要你的血。
我降落的地方，就是猎场。
lines.en: Where I land becomes the hunting ground.

lines.zh: 用爪子轻触目标，感受其生命。
lines.en: Taps target with a claw, feeling its life.

lines.zh: 靠近目标，呼吸变得沉重。
用触须感知目标的体温。
lines.en: Uses antennae to sense target's warmth.

lines.zh: 在目标周围徘徊，寻找破绽。
lines.en: Loiters around target, searching for weaknesses.

lines.zh: 用触须轻触目标，感知其气息。
lines.en: Gently touches target with antennae, sensing its presence.

lines.zh: 在目标周围踱步，寻找机会。
lines.en: Walks around target, looking for an opening.

lines.zh: 盯着目标，发出警告的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Glares at target, hissing a warning.

lines.zh: 用爪子轻触目标，感受其恐惧。
lines.en: Taps target with a claw, sensing its fear.

lines.zh: 我落点算好了，就在你脚边。
lines.en: I have picked my landing spot: your feet.

lines.zh: 这一击从高处来，你挡不住。
lines.en: This blow comes from above; you cannot block it.

lines.zh: 我的刀锋对准了你的影子。
lines.en: My edge points at your shadow.
You should not be on the surface.

lines.zh: 我数完了你的逃跑路线。
lines.en: I have counted all your escape routes.

lines.zh: 这个房间，只留我进来的门。
lines.en: This room keeps only the door I came through.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把会先熄灭。
lines.en: Your torch will go out first.
I wait for you to speak, then I strike.

lines.zh: 坠落的声音，就是你的丧钟。
lines.en: The sound of my fall is your bell.

lines.zh: 我从上面掉下来的，快让开。
lines.en: I am dropping from above; move aside.

lines.zh: 金属般的声音敲击着你的耳朵！
lines.en: The sound like metal ringing in your ears!
I'll bite you until you disappear!

lines.zh: 我的刀片会割破你的皮肉！
lines.en: My blades will cut through your skin!

lines.zh: 你的血肉无法填满我的饥饿！
lines.en: Your flesh can't satisfy my hunger!
Enjoy the pain for a moment!

lines.zh: 一刀横过，墙壁留下裂缝。
lines.en: One sweep and the wall is gashed.

lines.zh: 我把你按在了世界的缝里。
lines.en: I press you into a seam of the world.
That blow curled even my blade.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲挡不住坠落之力。
lines.en: Your armor cannot stop a falling world.
What I cut is your name.

lines.zh: 疼痛会告诉你这是真的。
lines.en: The pain will prove this is real.
One cut, and every shadow of the tree is severed.

lines.zh: 骨头的响声，我听得清楚。
lines.en: I hear your bones answer clearly.

lines.zh: 这一击带着整段剧情的重量。
lines.en: This strike carries the weight of the whole story.

lines.zh: 第一次失手，就是最后一次。
lines.en: Your first miss will be your last.
The ground split and I fell through.
You don't know how powerful I am!
I'll awaken you from the ground!

lines.zh: 我从上面落下来，砸在地上。
lines.en: I drop from above and hit the ground.
The sky split, and I dropped through.

lines.zh: 落地时，地面陷了一个坑。
lines.en: The ground sank into a pit where I landed.

lines.zh: 我来的时候，树叶全停了。
lines.en: When I arrive, every leaf stops moving.

lines.zh: 你听见头顶的破空声了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that tearing sound overhead?

lines.zh: 坠落登场的我，也会被法术咬一口。
lines.en: Even one who falls from above can be bitten by magic.
